title: Cost of Fixing a Bug Across SDLC Phases
description: An interactive Chart.js horizontal bar chart on a logarithmic scale showing the relative cost of remediating a security defect by the phase it is discovered, from 1x in requirements to 100x in production after a breach, with hover tooltips naming activities and cost drivers.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Interpret a logarithmic cost curve across the software development lifecycle.
Explain why remediation cost grows geometrically with the phase of discovery.
Argue for shifting security activities earlier (shift left).
prerequisites: Familiarity with the software development lifecycle

instructionalStrategies: Hover each bar to connect a phase to its typical activities and the driver of its cost.
Have students estimate the cost ratio between two phases before revealing the multipliers.

assessmentQuestions.question: Why is the x-axis logarithmic rather than linear here?
Your team has budget for one new security activity. Where on the curve should you spend it, and why?
